div.div:
Every edge is written in both directions at ingestion time (DynamoDB adjacency-list, not a graph database).
same_brand / same_category traversal = 2 hops (product to Brand/Category node to a sibling product).
co_reviewed = 1 hop (written product-to-product directly).
